theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R δ : ℝ) (g₀ : Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < δ → Measurable g₀ → (∀ x, |g₀ x| ≤ 1) → (∀ x, R ≤ ‖x‖ → g₀ x = 0) → ∃ G : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (G j)) ∧ (∀ j, HasCompactSupport (G j)) ∧ (∀ j, tsupport (G j) ⊆ ball 0 (R + δ)) ∧ (∀ j x, |G j x| ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Euclid n)), Tendsto (fun j => G j x) atTop (𝓝 (g₀ x))
